data_fields.name: clip_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: default 5; per-clip value from cache opcode 5

data_fields.name: lock_flag
data_fields.donor_constant: animProtect 0 = off; any non-zero value refuses every request (Player only)

data_fields.name: clip_start_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: passed by the script; sent as one byte; client unit not read

data_fields.name: empty_slot_value
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 for clip and delay, reset at end of tick

best_idea: A one-slot clip arbiter with a priority gate and a lock flag, cleared at the end of each tick, gives a fight a simple rule for which reaction or attack clip shows when several requests land in the same tick.
decision_why: Take the priority gate and lock-flag shape for the hero clip slot, but not the per-tick clear: hit reactions and finishers must hold across ticks, which needs a client timer this donor does not show. Priority values belong in the clip catalogue (rows 20-21), not in the function.
acceptance: Two hits in one tick from up to 3 attackers: the higher-priority reaction clip shows (finisher 9 beats hit reaction 2). While a finisher lock is set no hit-reaction clip is requested, and a server test shows the hit damage still applies with the clip locked.
